name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship
amount_text: Full tuition fee waiver plus a €10000 stipend for one year
how_to_apply: Apply to the HEA once you hold a conditional or final offer from an Irish university. About 60 awards a year nationally.
deadline_text: The call usually closes in March

name: UCD Global Excellence Scholarship (V.V. Giri for Indian residents)
how_to_apply: Separate scholarship application after you receive a UCD offer. Indian nationals living in India are considered for the V.V. Giri award.
deadline_text: Regional deadlines apply; check the official page

name: Trinity Global Excellence Postgraduate Scholarship
how_to_apply: Email your offer letter; CV and a 200-word statement to Trinity's regional officer for India.

name: UCC Science and Engineering international merit scholarship
amount_text: 20% off tuition for a First Class Honours equivalent
how_to_apply: Awarded automatically at offer stage based on your degree results.

name: UCC Business and Law excellence merit scholarship
amount_text: 20% off tuition for First Class Honours equivalent; 10% for 2:1
how_to_apply: Awarded automatically at offer stage based on your degree results.

name: University of Galway Science and Engineering merit and excellence scholarships
amount_text: €2000 merit scholarships; a limited number of €10000 excellence awards on selected programmes
how_to_apply: Accept your offer and pay the deposit to receive merit and excellence awards on eligible programmes.

name: DCU Merit Scholarship
how_to_apply: You are automatically considered when you apply to DCU as a non-EU student.

name: UL Science and Engineering international merit scholarship
how_to_apply: You are automatically reviewed for a scholarship when you apply.

name: Maynooth University Taught Master's Scholarship
amount_text: €2000 off tuition; International Office schemes offer more
how_to_apply: Awarded on academic excellence; non-EU students should also check the International Office schemes.
